abstract.t:
This document specifies a data model for managing server-side mail filtering rules with the JSON Meta Application Protocol (JMAP). A rule combines a set of conditions, such as the sender address or the message subject, with a set of actions, such as filing the message into a mailbox or forwarding it. The model is designed to be presented and edited through simple user interface components, and every condition and action is defined in terms of an equivalent construct of the Sieve mail filtering language, so that rules have precise and interoperable semantics and servers that implement Sieve can support this extension by translating rules into Sieve scripts.
This document also defines lists of safe and blocked senders and describes how rules interact with the JMAP VacationResponse object.
